claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile, put N=sum_i r_i, a_r=#arity-r branches, h=1+2a_2+4a_3+7a_4, C=(1+2z)product_i B_{r_i}, E=z(1+z)^N, U_i=(1+2z)B_{r_i-1}product_{ell!=i}B_{r_ell}, and M_k(E)=E[k]C[k]-E[k+1]C[k-1].
